slides.headline: The 10-minute test for any AI tool.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.right:
Test it on your
own real task.

slides.label: Check 1
slides.title: Pick a real task
slides.card: Choose one task you did this week. Write down how long it took you.

slides.label: Check 2
slides.title: Run it and time it
slides.card: Do the task with your real inputs. Did it beat your old way?

slides.label: Check 3
slides.title: Beat the free option
slides.card: Run the same task in a free tool. Which result needs less editing?

slides.label: Check 4
slides.title: Read the fine print
slides.card: Does it train on my data? Can I export my work? Can I cancel easily?
slides.note: Look in settings and the privacy page.

slides.label: Check 5
slides.title: Set a cancel date
slides.card: Add a reminder 2 days before the trial ends. Keep it only if you used it.

slides.headline: Which AI tool do you pay for?
slides.sub: Save this before your next free trial.

scenes.label: THE SLOW WAY
scenes.wrong: Writing it from scratch at 5 pm

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Here are my notes from this week: [paste]. Write a client update: what we finished, what's in progress, what I need from them, next week's plan. Friendly, under 120 words. Ask me if anything is unclear.
Send this to a freelancer who hates updates.
scenes.note: Remove private client details before you paste.
